messages.content: Fixed the CrossEntropyLoss error in cell 7. The issue was that CrossEntropyLoss expects label indices (0D or 1D tensor) but one-hot encoded labels (2D tensor) were being passed. The fix converts one-hot encoded labels to class indices using `torch.argmax(label, dim=1)` before passing to the loss function. This ensures the loss calculation uses the correct tensor format expected by PyTorch's CrossEntropyLoss.

extra.submission: Fixed the CrossEntropyLoss error in cell 7. The issue was that CrossEntropyLoss expects label indices (0D or 1D tensor) but one-hot encoded labels (2D tensor) were being passed. The fix converts one-hot encoded labels to class indices using `torch.argmax(label, dim=1)` before passing to the loss function. This ensures the loss calculation uses the correct tensor format expected by PyTorch's CrossEntropyLoss.
